meta.title: Conway County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Conway County's 2026 budget workbook as filed with the state. We use the "Projected 2026" column, not the 2025 column next to it. Some funds move money to other funds or to a health savings reserve (transfer lines); money moved between county funds shows up in both funds. The workbook isn’t the adopted ordinance: one fund’s (3045) lines are missing from the print, and the other funds come to $7,249.99 less than its printed “Total Budgeted Funds.” The adopted ordinance is a records request away.
